title: What marching taught; studies, baseball and tennis
summary: Thomas says marching taught respect for the instrument and the conductor. He was a good student who also played baseball and tennis.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, I mean that was all very good to have as a musician whether you liked it or not.
Yeah, tremendous. You have a chance to know respect for the instrument. You have a chance to know respect for the conductor and the guys right there with you. And, it's a beautiful experience.
And what about, at the same time you were getting a full education.

I was a good student Yeah, it-was-a-good-school. I liked books so there wasn't any problem. And I liked athletics and I played some baseball. We used to go -- the same school that I'm telling you about I still think it was music. We'd go back and play baseball.
Sumner. Lost every damn game. And my dad and my brother would be there and lost every damn game we ever had. always Tennis, I always liked tennis. I thought all these things
